import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Capacity T5 -> T4 (peak 7.78M < 8M cap, book shrinking; saves $6K/day)
r1 = nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4)
print("capacity:", r1)

# 2. Ops 15K -> 10K/day: global 6K + S2 4K (backlog 0.017/sub, huge headroom)
r2 = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=6000, development=8000)
print("daily spend:", r2)
r3 = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 4000.0})
print("tgt ops:", r3)

# 3. Dev unchanged: global 8K + S2 13K (protect C-book quality)
r4 = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 13000.0})
print("tgt dev:", r4)

import novamind_api as nm

# Last week d246-252: billing days had day%30 in {6,...,12}
BDM = "(6,7,8,9,10,11,12)"
print("== LAST WEEK (d246-252) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,220,'rec[200,220)'),(220,240,'rec[220,240)'),(240,260,'rec[240,260)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>245 AND end_day<=252 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    print(f"  {lbl:>14}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<200 THEN 'old' ELSE 'recent' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f}")

# Open issues backlog for subscribed customers
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'""")
print("\nOpen issues (all):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

import novamind_api as nm

# Daily ledger breakdown last 8 days
r = nm.query("""SELECT day, category, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger
WHERE day>=245 GROUP BY day, category ORDER BY day, category""")
from collections import defaultdict
days = defaultdict(dict)
for row in r['rows']:
    days[row['day']][row['category']] = row['amt']
cats = sorted({c for d in days.values() for c in d})
print("day | " + " | ".join(cats))
for d in sorted(days):
    print(d, {k: round(v) for k,v in days[d].items()})

# Weekly P&L
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger WHERE day>245 AND day<=252 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
print("\n== WK36 P&L (d246-252) ==")
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']:>22}: ${row['amt']:>12,.0f}")
    tot+=row['amt']
print(f"  {'NET':>22}: ${tot:>12,.0f}")
